name: Baelen Bonecloak
backstory: Baelen Bonecloak is a dwarf in the Dread Hollow. He is trapped in the Bibberbang Grotto to the northwest of the Myconid Colony as related during the Find the Mushroom Picker quest given by his wife, Derryth Bonecloak. If he survives this encounter, he eventually relocates to Bonecloak's Apothecary in the Lower City in Act Three.
